# Performance Testing Tools

A decision-ready, curated directory of 54 performance testing tools (2026) from QAInsights.
Canonical site: https://perf.jmeter.ai

## How to choose a load testing tool

1. Start from **protocol coverage** (HTTP, gRPC, browser, legacy), not brand familiarity.
2. Match **authoring model** to the team: GUI/recorder, code-first (JS/Python/Java/Scala), or pure CLI.
3. Decide **cloud vs self-hosted** for load generation, data residency, and cost predictability.
4. Check **lifecycle status**. Discontinued tools stay listed here with successors when known.
5. Shortlist 2-3 options and compare specs in the Test Rig before a proof-of-concept.

## Canonical compare pairs

### Apache JMeter vs Grafana k6
Both are open source. Both deploy as self-hosted. Scripting: Apache JMeter (Java, Groovy) vs Grafana k6 (JavaScript, TypeScript). Choose Apache JMeter when you need load testing strengths around HTTP, HTTPS, JDBC; choose Grafana k6 for load testing with HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket.
Links: [Apache JMeter](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/apache-jmeter) · [Grafana k6](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/grafana-k6) · [Compare](https://perf.jmeter.ai/compare?tools=apache-jmeter,grafana-k6)

### Apache JMeter vs Gatling
Both are open source. Both deploy as self-hosted. Scripting: Apache JMeter (Java, Groovy) vs Gatling (Java, Scala, Kotlin). Choose Apache JMeter when you need load testing strengths around HTTP, HTTPS, JDBC; choose Gatling for load testing with HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket.
Links: [Apache JMeter](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/apache-jmeter) · [Gatling](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/gatling) · [Compare](https://perf.jmeter.ai/compare?tools=apache-jmeter,gatling)

### Grafana k6 vs Gatling
Both are open source. Both deploy as self-hosted. Scripting: Grafana k6 (JavaScript, TypeScript) vs Gatling (Java, Scala, Kotlin). Choose Grafana k6 when you need load testing strengths around HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket; choose Gatling for load testing with HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket.
Links: [Grafana k6](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/grafana-k6) · [Gatling](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/gatling) · [Compare](https://perf.jmeter.ai/compare?tools=gatling,grafana-k6)

### Locust vs Grafana k6
Both are open source. Both deploy as self-hosted. Scripting: Locust (Python) vs Grafana k6 (JavaScript, TypeScript). Choose Locust when you need load testing strengths around HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket; choose Grafana k6 for load testing with HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket.
Links: [Locust](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/locust) · [Grafana k6](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/grafana-k6) · [Compare](https://perf.jmeter.ai/compare?tools=grafana-k6,locust)

### Apache JMeter vs LoadRunner Professional
Apache JMeter is open source; LoadRunner Professional is commercial. Both deploy as self-hosted. Scripting: Apache JMeter (Java, Groovy) vs LoadRunner Professional (C, JavaScript, C#). Choose Apache JMeter when you need load testing strengths around HTTP, HTTPS, JDBC; choose LoadRunner Professional for enterprise suite with HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket.
Links: [Apache JMeter](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/apache-jmeter) · [LoadRunner Professional](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/loadrunner-professional) · [Compare](https://perf.jmeter.ai/compare?tools=apache-jmeter,loadrunner-professional)

### BlazeMeter vs Grafana Cloud k6
BlazeMeter is commercial; Grafana Cloud k6 is freemium. Both deploy as cloud. Scripting: BlazeMeter (Java, JavaScript, Python) vs Grafana Cloud k6 (JavaScript, TypeScript). Choose BlazeMeter when you need cloud load testing strengths around HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket; choose Grafana Cloud k6 for cloud load testing with HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket.
Links: [BlazeMeter](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/blazemeter) · [Grafana Cloud k6](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/grafana-cloud-k6) · [Compare](https://perf.jmeter.ai/compare?tools=blazemeter,grafana-cloud-k6)

### OctoPerf vs BlazeMeter
OctoPerf is freemium; BlazeMeter is commercial. OctoPerf is hybrid; BlazeMeter is cloud. Scripting: OctoPerf (Java, Groovy) vs BlazeMeter (Java, JavaScript, Python). Choose OctoPerf when you need cloud load testing strengths around HTTP, HTTPS, JDBC; choose BlazeMeter for cloud load testing with HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket.
Links: [OctoPerf](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/octoperf) · [BlazeMeter](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/blazemeter) · [Compare](https://perf.jmeter.ai/compare?tools=blazemeter,octoperf)

### Artillery vs Grafana k6
Both are open source. Both deploy as self-hosted. Scripting: Artillery (JavaScript, TypeScript) vs Grafana k6 (JavaScript, TypeScript). Choose Artillery when you need protocol/api load strengths around HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket; choose Grafana k6 for load testing with HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket.
Links: [Artillery](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/artillery) · [Grafana k6](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/grafana-k6) · [Compare](https://perf.jmeter.ai/compare?tools=artillery,grafana-k6)

## Full tool index

- [Apache JMeter](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/apache-jmeter) Open-source Java application for load testing and measuring performance of web and other services. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [BlazeMeter](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/blazemeter) Cloud platform for performance testing, test data, continuous testing, and observability workflows. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [LoadRunner Professional](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/loadrunner-professional) Enterprise performance testing software for web, API, packaged, and legacy applications. License: Commercial; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [LoadRunner Enterprise](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/loadrunner-enterprise) Web-based enterprise platform for planning, executing, and analyzing performance tests. License: Commercial; deployment: Hybrid; status: Active.
- [LoadRunner Cloud](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/loadrunner-cloud) SaaS performance testing service with cloud load generators and enterprise test management. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [Locust](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/locust) Open-source, Python-based framework for writing scalable user behavior load tests. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Gatling](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/gatling) Code-driven load testing tool with expressive scenarios and high-throughput asynchronous engines. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Gatling Enterprise](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/gatling-enterprise) Managed Gatling platform for distributed testing, observability, and team workflows. License: Commercial; deployment: Hybrid; status: Active.
- [NeoLoad](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/neoload) Enterprise performance testing platform for web, API, mobile, and packaged applications. License: Commercial; deployment: Hybrid; status: Active.
- [LoadFocus](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/loadfocus) Cloud service for load, performance, and synthetic monitoring tests. License: Freemium; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [Flood](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/flood) Cloud load testing platform historically used to run JMeter and Gatling tests. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Discontinued.
- [Loader.io](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/loaderio) Hosted HTTP load testing service for APIs and web applications. License: Freemium; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [RedLine13](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/redline13) Freemium cloud load testing platform that runs tests in a customer AWS account. License: Freemium; deployment: Hybrid; status: Active.
- [Nouvola](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/nouvola) Discontinued cloud performance testing platform for web, mobile, and API applications. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Discontinued.
- [StormForger](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/stormforger) Discontinued SaaS performance testing service acquired and rebranded as StormForge. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Discontinued.
- [StresStimulus](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/stresstimulus) Windows load testing tool for web, REST, SOAP, and WCF applications. License: Commercial; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [PureLoad](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/pureload) Commercial functional and performance testing software for applications and mobile networks. License: Commercial; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Grafana k6](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/grafana-k6) Open-source developer-centric load testing tool with JavaScript or TypeScript test scripts. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Grafana Cloud k6](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/grafana-cloud-k6) Hosted Grafana service for running k6 tests with dashboards and distributed load generation. License: Freemium; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [OctoPerf](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/octoperf) SaaS and on-premises performance testing platform built around Apache JMeter. License: Freemium; deployment: Hybrid; status: Active.
- [WebLOAD](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/webload) Enterprise load testing solution for web, mobile, and API applications. License: Commercial; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Load Multiplier](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/load-multiplier) Discontinued hosted load testing product listed in the original QAInsights diagram. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Discontinued.
- [Apica](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/apica) Observability platform with synthetic monitoring and load-testing capabilities for digital experiences. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [WAPT Pro](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/wapt-pro) Windows load testing tool for web applications, APIs, and web services. License: Commercial; deployment: Hybrid; status: Active.
- [Frugal Testing](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/frugal-testing) Cloud-based performance testing service offering managed load generation and reporting. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [AgileLoad](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/agileload) Discontinued performance testing product formerly offered by Quotium Technologies. License: Commercial; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Discontinued.
- [LoadStorm](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/loadstorm) Cloud load testing service for web applications and APIs. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Discontinued.
- [Appvance AIQ](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/appvance-iq) AI-assisted enterprise platform for functional, performance, security, and continuous testing. License: Commercial; deployment: Hybrid; status: Active.
- [Artillery](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/artillery) Developer-first load testing toolkit for HTTP, WebSocket, and messaging systems. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Artillery Cloud](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/artillery-cloud) Managed Artillery execution and observability for distributed performance tests. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [Rational Performance Tester](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/rational-performance-tester) Enterprise performance testing software for web and service applications. License: Commercial; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Discontinued.
- [Loadster](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/loadster) Load testing application for browser-like web workflows and APIs. License: Commercial; deployment: Hybrid; status: Active.
- [Silk Performer](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/silk-performer) Enterprise performance testing suite for web, mobile, and distributed applications. License: Commercial; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [LoadNinja](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/loadninja) Cloud performance testing tool that uses real browsers and minimal scripting. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [Azure Load Testing](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/azure-load-testing) Fully managed Azure service for running high-scale Apache JMeter load tests. License: Commercial; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [AWS Distributed Load Testing](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/aws-distributed-load-testing) AWS solution for deploying distributed load tests using containerized open-source engines. License: Open Source; deployment: Cloud; status: Active.
- [Vegeta](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/vegeta) HTTP load testing command-line utility designed for constant request rates. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [wrk](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/wrk) Modern HTTP benchmarking tool capable of generating significant load from a single machine. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [hey](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/hey) Small command-line HTTP load generator for quick endpoint benchmarks. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Bombardier](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/bombardier) Fast cross-platform HTTP(S) benchmarking tool written in Go. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Taurus](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/taurus) Open-source automation framework that configures and runs multiple performance testing engines. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Tsung](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/tsung) Distributed open-source load testing tool for HTTP, WebDAV, LDAP, and other protocols. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Siege](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/siege) Open-source command-line utility for HTTP regression and benchmarking tests. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [ApacheBench (ab)](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/apachebench) Minimal HTTP server benchmarking command included with Apache HTTP Server. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Fortio](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/fortio) Fast, embeddable HTTP and gRPC load testing and latency tool. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Drill](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/drill) HTTP load testing application with YAML scenarios and a command-line interface. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Goose](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/goose) Rust framework for building realistic, asynchronous load test clients. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [JMeter Plugins](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/jmeter-plugins) Community plugin ecosystem extending Apache JMeter components, listeners, and load generators. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [wrk2](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/wrk2) Constant-throughput HTTP benchmark based on wrk for latency-oriented testing. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [tcpkali](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/tcpkali) High-performance TCP and WebSocket load generator for connection-oriented services. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Discontinued.
- [ghz](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/ghz) Open-source command-line gRPC benchmarking and load testing tool. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Autocannon](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/autocannon) Node.js HTTP/1.1 benchmarking tool optimized for quick, high-throughput tests. License: Open Source; deployment: Self-hosted; status: Active.
- [Reqfleet](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/reqfleet) Cloud-native platform for distributed JMeter and Locust load tests with public or private regions and per-minute billing. License: Freemium; deployment: Hybrid; status: Active.
- [k6 Cloud](https://perf.jmeter.ai/tools/k6-cloud-legacy) Former name for the hosted k6 service, now branded Grafana Cloud k6. License: Freemium; deployment: Cloud; status: Discontinued.
